name: 2026 RD39
verdict_text: Clearly seen in SPHEREx photos 60 days before anyone found it.

story.plain: A small near-Earth asteroid found in September 2026. Its orbit was based on only a few weeks of watching. One older photo two months earlier stretches that arc a lot.

cloud.note: Sample: clones drawn from made-up uncertainties around the real orbit. after = with the Rewind positions added; null if nothing measured.

quiz.answer_text: Yes. The dot in the middle is the asteroid, exactly where its orbit says it should be.
